beats.event: Seven-year-old Pip meets an escaped convict in the graveyard
Pip steals food and a file to help the convict
Soldiers recapture the convict
Miss Havisham summons Pip to her decaying mansion
Pip meets Estella and falls in love with her
Orlick attacks Pip's sister in a jealous rage
Jaggers reveals an anonymous benefactor has made Pip a gentleman
Pip moves to London, lodging with Herbert Pocket
Joe visits London; Pip is ashamed of him
Pip meets Estella in society and grows infatuated
Pip and Herbert accumulate debts
Pip learns the convict Magwitch is his true benefactor
Pip devises an escape plan for Magwitch
Magwitch reveals Compeyson defrauded Miss Havisham
Pip confronts Miss Havisham about the misleading expectations
Orlick lures Pip to the marshes; Herbert rescues him
Magwitch's escape fails on the Thames; Compeyson drowns
Magwitch dies after trial; Joe nurses Pip through illness
Pip returns to marry Biddy but finds she has married Joe
Years later Pip meets widowed Estella in Satis House ruins
